## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 3-fascicle text by [鳩摩羅什](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%B3%A9%E6%91%A9%E7%BE%85%E4%BB%80) Kumārajīva is the second Chinese version of the *Sarvapuṇya-samuccaya-samādhi-sūtra*, parallel to [竺法護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AB%BA%E6%B3%95%E8%AD%B7) Zhú Fǎhù's earlier *Děng jí zhòng dé sānmèi jīng* 等集眾德三昧經 ([KR6g0027](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0027), T0381).

**Abstract**

The translation belongs to Kumārajīva's Cháng'ān period (402–412 CE).
